items.title: Show HN: Semble – Code search for agents that uses 98% fewer tokens than grep
items.whyItMatters: 98% token reduction on code search is a real loop-cost win — worth dropping into any agent that currently greps large repos.

items.title: I don't think AI will make your processes go faster
items.whyItMatters: The constraint is usually coordination overhead, not raw compute — a useful stress-test for anyone selling AI as a throughput multiplier.

items.title: Apple Silicon costs more than OpenRouter
items.whyItMatters: Concrete energy/cost numbers for local vs cloud inference — the gap is narrower than assumed once idle power is factored in.

items.title: Anthropic acquires Stainless
items.whyItMatters: Stainless auto-generates typed SDK wrappers — in-house likely means tighter API versioning and faster multi-language SDK releases from Anthropic.

items.title: Linux security mailing list 'almost unmanageable'
items.whyItMatters: AI-generated CVE submissions flooding kernel security triagers — a preview of the signal-to-noise problem every OSS project will face.
